claims.text: Generalized edema: CBC, electrolytes, BUN, creatinine, liver tests, serum protein and urinalysis (protein, microscopic hematuria).
claims.quote: For most patients with generalized edema, testing should include complete blood count (CBC), serum electrolytes, blood urea nitrogen (BUN), creatinine, liver tests, serum protein, and urinalysis (particularly noting the presence of protein and microscopic hematuria).

claims.text: By suspected cause: BNP for heart failure, D-dimer for pulmonary embolism.
claims.quote: brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) for suspected heart failure or D-dimer for suspected pulmonary embolism

claims.text: Isolated leg swelling: ultrasound to exclude venous obstruction.
claims.quote: Patients with isolated lower-extremity swelling should usually have venous obstruction excluded by ultrasound.
